list: The official 55 PS5 trophies, as published on PlayStation Network and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (2026-11-18): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names and descriptions are the official ones, verbatim. Guides, kinds, stages and flags are this app's own work and cite their sources per trophy.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN progress targets
GTA-Zone — GTA 6 trophy list and roadmap notes

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum is automatic: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Work the roadmap stages in order, keep an eye on the long counters, and this lights up on its own at 54 of 54. PowerPyx rates the full Platinum at roughly 200 hours and 4 out of 10 difficulty (via GTA-Zone), so treat it as a marathon, not a skill wall.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies
The Platinum unlocks by itself — no extra task

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. It cannot be missed: simply play through the prologue and the trophy pops as the mission wraps up. It is the first trophy most players will earn.
steps: Start the story
Play through the Gone Fishing mission to its end

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN progress targets

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Before you close the chapter out, stop at the meditation spot on Lucia's balcony: that spot belongs to Positive Mental Attitude and is only there during Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay to go back for it (PowerPyx, via GTA-Zone; Output Lag). Keep a manual save at the chapter's start as insurance.
steps: Play Chapter 1 through to its final mission
Meditate on Lucia's balcony before finishing the chapter

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN progress targets

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story; the name is printed with asterisks by PlayStation itself. Chapter 2 is also where the game opens up: several trophies need Jason and Lucia together, and most of the list becomes available once both are playable from this chapter on (Output Lag). Make a fresh manual save when the chapter begins.
steps: Play Chapter 2 through to its final mission
Save manually at the chapter start

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN progress targets

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Story chapters cannot be replayed, but nothing in this chapter is missable, so play it straight through. Keep the habit of a manual save at the chapter's start anyway — it protects the one genuinely missable trophy earlier in the run and costs nothing.
steps: Play Chapter 3 through to its final mission

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN progress targets

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. After this chapter only the endgame remains, so it is a good moment to sweep up stranger strands and counters before the finale. Save manually before starting the final mission when you get there.
steps: Play Chapter 4 through to its final mission

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN progress targets

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of only two gold trophies: finish the campaign's final mission. The story runs about 60 hours on its own (reviews, via PlanetGTA6), and finishing it also unlocks the cheat codes — though using a cheat disables trophies and saving, so leave them alone on a Platinum run (PowerPyx, via PlanetGTA6). Make a manual save before the final mission, as Output Lag advises, so the endgame is never a one-way door.
steps: Reach the final mission
Save manually before starting it
Complete it

Complete the mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold, and the spine of the whole Platinum: bring the game's completion stat to 100 percent. Work the in-game completion checklist — story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and world tasks all feed it — and use this tracker to see which counters are still short. GTA-Zone confirms nothing on the 100 percent checklist is missable, so it is purely a matter of hours: most of the roughly 200-hour Platinum estimate is spent here (PowerPyx, via GTA-Zone).
steps: Finish the story first
Clear every strand, collectible set and activity the checklist counts
Check the in-game completion stat until it reads 100%

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: A silver counter trophy: land 250 stunts, tracked by PSN as you go (PSNProfiles). Stunts register while driving and riding around Leonida, so weave them into exploration and races instead of grinding them in one sitting, and log your count here after each session. No source has yet published a verified stunt-by-stunt location list, so this guide will not invent one — the counter and steady play are the honest route.
steps: Attempt stunts whenever you travel — jumps, flips and near-miss style feats
Track the PSN count here after each session
Reach 250

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every kind of activity the game offers — PSN counts 9 activity types in total (PSNProfiles). Whenever a new activity icon appears on the map, try it once instead of driving past: races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races and the arcade all count toward the spread. It pairs naturally with the early hours, when most activity types are still new.
steps: Try one activity of each new type as it appears on the map
Keep the count here until all 9 types are sampled

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: A silver skill trophy: take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a count PSN tracks per challenge (PSNProfiles). Learn one weapon class at a time and replay a challenge immediately while its target pattern is fresh — medals reward accuracy and streaks more than raw speed. Challenges can be retried freely, so nothing here is missable; it is the list's purest test of aim.
steps: Unlock the Shooting Range challenges
Gold-medal each of the 42 challenges, replaying freely
Log each gold here as it lands

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location that hosts one. New race locations surface as you explore Leonida, so check the map after each new district opens and clear the local race while you are nearby. A win at each location is what counts — a single favourite course, however fast, only covers its own spot.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location as the map opens
Win the race at every location

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word 'different' is the catch, because repeating one easy race twenty times does not advance the count (PSN tracks the total to 20, per PSNProfiles). Spread your wins across the race types and districts as they unlock, and tick each new race off here the first time you win it.
steps: Enter races across Leonida as they unlock
Win 20 distinct ones — no repeats count

Out-fish him once

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The one trophy the guides flag as potentially missable: a meditation spot on Lucia's balcony exists only during Chapter 1 and is gone once the chapter ends, and the game has no mission replay. Meditate there during Chapter 1 and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter (PowerPyx via GTA-Zone; Output Lag).
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots spread across Leonida — PSN tracks the count to 18 (PSNProfiles). One spot sits on Lucia's balcony and exists only during Chapter 1: meditate there before the chapter ends, because there is no mission replay to return for it, which is why PowerPyx flags this as the list's one potentially missable trophy (via GTA-Zone; also Output Lag). The remaining spots can be visited as you explore, with Jason and Lucia between them.

Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter
Visit the remaining spots across Leonida until the count reads 18

Log the running count here

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges, tracked by PSN to 50 (PSNProfiles). Challenges surface through play — activities, exploration and world events all feed the pool — so accept them as they appear instead of saving them for a single grind. Keep the count updated here and the trophy lands well before the 100 percent push.
steps: Take on Challenges as they appear in the world
Complete 50 of them

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: A partner trophy: with Jason and Lucia together, raise a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely while staying together. It needs both protagonists playable, which the game opens up from Chapter 2 (Output Lag). Deliberately build the heat away from dense police areas, then break line of sight and hide until the stars drain — escaping is the trophy, not the crime spree.
steps: Play as the pair, from Chapter 2 on
Raise the wanted level to 4 stars together
Break away and stay hidden until the level is fully lost

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: A partner trophy with a chain condition: rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping a wanted level the whole time — if the stars fully drain between shops, the chain breaks (the count of 3 is the official requirement, per the PSN list on Exophase). Pick a cluster of shops close together, move fast between them, and keep the heat simmering rather than escaping it. Both protagonists are playable together from Chapter 2 (Output Lag).
steps: Group up as Jason and Lucia
Rob a first shop and keep the wanted level alive
Hit two more shops back-to-back without the stars clearing

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles, tracked by PSN to 100 (PSNProfiles). Make a habit of getting into any car, boat or bike you have not driven before — traffic variety changes by district and time of day, so exploring new areas fills this in naturally. Log the count here after long drives and it should complete long before the endgame.
steps: Enter every new vehicle model you see
Vary districts to widen the traffic pool
Reach 100 discovered vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aiming ability. Set the moment up rather than hoping for it: start a fight against a group of five or more, position with clear sightlines, then trigger Combat Focus and work target to target before it runs out. Failed attempts cost nothing — any busy firefight is another try.
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies in view
Activate Combat Focus
Take down 5 before it ends

The natural reading is to take an aircraft from the airport under your own power outside any mission or scheduled flight, and get airborne. Expect a wanted level for it, so plan the getaway before you roll.

Take an aircraft outside any mission
Get airborne and away

Survive the encounter

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected — stealth is the whole trophy. Scout the store first, approach quietly, keep weapons and witnesses under control, and leave before anyone raises the alarm; if you are spotted, walk away and try another store rather than forcing it. Detection, not the escape, is what fails the attempt.

Enter quietly and rob it without being seen
Slip away before any alarm

Treat each bank as a small heist: plan the exit vehicle and route before going in, and vary which banks you hit as new ones become reachable.

Stop and rob it

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Permanent-choice caution: the choices that move your Criminal Profile add up, and pushing the profile all the way to 'Irredeemable' is permanent (GTA-Zone). The trophy itself is not missable, but the profile you build along the way cannot be undone — do not max out the extreme for fun on a save you care about.
trophies.guide: A hidden counter trophy: the choices you make that shape your Criminal Profile accumulate, and PSN tracks the count to 500 (PSNProfiles). Play deliberately rather than randomly — each qualifying choice moves the profile — and keep an eye on the far end of the scale: GTA-Zone notes that pushing the profile to 'Irredeemable' is permanent, so steer your choices rather than slamming one extreme. Five hundred choices is a whole playthrough's worth, so this lands late.
steps: Make profile-shaping choices as they arise
Track the count toward 500 here
Avoid pinning the profile at 'Irredeemable' unless you mean it — it is permanent

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, as the official description sets out. Whenever you take a vehicle you intend to keep or use, register it in the app there and then; ten registrations accumulate quickly once the habit forms, and it pairs with Whip It Good's vehicle discovering.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app when you take a new vehicle
Register it
Reach 10 registered vehicles
